name: App Link
main_effect:
While you have Digimon or Tamer with the [Appmon] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Appmon] or [App Driver] trait among them to the hand. Trash the rest. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[End of Your Turn] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・You may link 1 card from your hand with 1 of your Digimon without paying the cost.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
set_name: LM-07: Limited Card Pack Another Knight
